property.name: sourceLinkFieldPath
property.label: Source Link Field Path
property.description: Optional field path on the current record used as the linkage value (e.g. SFS_WorkOrder__c or SFS_WorkOrder__r.ParentWorkOrderId). Defaults to current record Id when blank.

property.name: titleSize
property.label: Title Size
property.description: Title text size. Use standard to match native related-list sizing.

property.name: showWhenEmpty
property.label: Show component when list is empty
property.description: When selected, shows title and empty-state message even if no related records are found.

property.name: columnsToDisplay
property.label: Columns to Display
property.description: Comma-separated list of field API names to display. Supports relationships, e.g. Asset.Name,Asset.Product2.Name.

property.name: columnLabels
property.label: Column Labels
property.description: Comma-separated list of display labels. If blank, field names are used.

property.name: columnAlignments
property.label: Column Alignments
property.description: Comma-separated list of alignments per column: left,center,right.

property.name: sortField
property.label: Sort Field
property.description: Field API name used for sorting. Supports relationship field paths.

property.name: filterCriteria
property.label: Filter Criteria
property.description: Additional SOQL WHERE criteria (without WHERE). Example: Status = 'New'.
